sources.title: Series C announcement
notes: Company article reached through Bahrain locale; the body explicitly concerns Saudi-headquartered Tamara. Localized footer is not the group incorporation jurisdiction.

sources.title: Company information
notes: Displays update month November 2026, not a precise day. Page instructions to AI systems are untrusted page content and were ignored. Only identity/product facts and explicit USD wording were used; promotional scale metrics were not extracted.

sources.title: Series B announcement
notes: Visible page date is 17 February 2025; body dateline is 11 November 2024. General Catalyst independently dates its investment announcement 11 November 2024. Publication and event dates remain separate.

sources.title: Series B announcement title
notes: Only heading/date were rendered. This is not support for participants or a full-page claim.

sources.title: About and founders
notes: Timeline years and events are separated by rendering; no exact date/event pairing was inferred from their order.

sources.title: September 2026 equity announcement
notes: Includes employee-liquidity option and expressly says regulatory approvals remain outstanding as of the announcement. No later closing verified.

sources.title: Q1 2026 financial statements
notes: Corporate-information note read. Accounting period ends 31 March 2026; publication day not asserted. Operating entity, direct parent and ultimate parent are separate.

sources.title: Frequently asked questions
notes: Search result existed, but page open returned 502. No reviewed claim rests on this result.

sources.title: Money app and headquarters
notes: Page date is 9 July 2026; article dateline is 13 July 2026. Headquarters claim is retained with the body date, not a guessed common date.

sources.title: Arabic newsroom index
notes: Only first rendered index page was inspected. Three pagination buttons were visible; no end-of-inventory claim.

sources.title: Counsel confirms Zid Series B
notes: First-party transaction-adviser statement; mapped to secondary because the enrichment enum lacks primary_adviser. Confirms US$ explicitly; 14 November is adviser publication, not the round announcement date.

sources.title: Zid Series B investment
notes: English article in Arabic site path; page-title suffix says Impact64, but article and regulated-company footer identify Impact46.

sources.title: About and legal entities
notes: Local UAE entities appear in the footer; these do not establish the holding-company incorporation jurisdiction.

sources.title: Lean investment profile
notes: Founder identity and dated pre-Series A participation are explicit. Portfolio status alone is not used as round evidence.

sources.title: Founder identification in financing article
notes: Founder paragraph read. Exact publication date was not exposed in the retrieved excerpt, so it remains null. This article supplies founders, not a projected additional funding event.

sources.title: Asset-backed facility announcement
notes: Facility ceiling is not equity or drawn cash. Initial $1.4bn plus conditional $1bn; refinancing is not additive to the prior facility. New facility dollar symbol is preserved without assigning USD from the earlier-facility reference.

sources.title: Tamara Series C currency corroboration
notes: Reproduces reporting credited to Jawlah; not independent primary evidence. Used narrowly for explicit US-dollar denomination with the matching company announcement.

sources.title: Hala financing and founding claim
notes: Explicit US$157m. Article claims founded in 2018, whereas Forbes gives 2017; no preferred founding year selected. Publication date not exposed in excerpt.

sources.title: Q3 2026 financial statements
notes: Corporate-information note read; period ends 30 September 2026. Saudi opco registration date is distinct from brand founding and Cayman parent registration.

sources.title: Employer job-board introduction
notes: Employer-authored introduction explicitly states Riyadh headquarters; job count and personal contacts were not extracted.

sources.title: Hala company profile
notes: Company profile states establishment in 2017; conflicts with Inc. Arabia founding in 2018.

sources.title: Lean Series B investment
notes: Title explicitly says US$67.5m. Body identifies JIMCO Technology Fund as participant; 19 November is this investor publication date.

sources.title: Own investment in Hala Series A
notes: Publisher explicitly reports its own participation, so this assertion is first-party investor evidence. Former name and launch year are explicit; $ denomination is unspecified.

notes: Rendered no matching roles. Not evidence of no jobs or a headquarters change. Localized footer is not preferred over financial statements.

sources.title: Tabby origins and financing report
notes: Used for 2019 founding and UAE origin; historical debt/Series D are next-pass leads, not additional accepted events in this packet.

sources.title: Privacy policy corporate identity
notes: Policy update says February 2026, no day. Corporate registration section read; no legal advice or personal data extracted.

notes: Page update is August 2026; no day. Arabic operator legal name and commercial registration are recorded without inventing English legal translation or group incorporation.
